courses.title: Private Zoom Curb Your Anxiety Package
courses.description: A private 75-minute Zoom session that combines breathing practices, chakra balancing, EFT tapping and Yoga Nidra with singing bowls to settle anxious feelings.

left_out: EFT Tapping sessions (Zoom $250, in person $200): their pages call EFT 'an alternative method to aid in the relief of anxiety', which could be read as an alternative to medical care; left out to be safe.
Private In-Person Curb Your Anxiety (from $300 USD): near-duplicate of the Zoom package (the original plan likewise kept one of each near-duplicate pair).
Sound healing sessions: still out (the page claims help with depression, pain and blood pressure); not reopened.
flags: Curb Your Anxiety: wellbeing framing (anxiety) with no claim to cure or treat. Price shown as $500 and '500 US dollars'.
